verdict.rationale: Docs show many core capabilities (building enrichments via prompt/spec, scraping, quick_search, search_agent, webhooks, dry_run) are all API-accessible, suggesting broad parity, but there is no explicit statement of full UI/API parity and some UI-highlighted features like scheduling refresh (riveter-docs-13, riveter-docs-17) aren't confirmed as API-exposed. Additionally, probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec (riveter-probe-2) or llms.txt (riveter-probe-1), undermining confidence that the API surface is fully documented/openly specified. missing for 10: explicit parity statement, API access to scheduling/monitoring feature, published OpenAPI spec for verification.
